messages:
maria: Heads up — Acme reported their webhook endpoint returning 403s since ~11:05 UTC. They only allowlist our old IPv4 block. Logs show connections from an IPv6 address we started using for egress.

sam: looking now. I can see the flows — we flipped the dual-stack cleanup job in us-west-2 at 11:03 which rebalanced a few customers onto an IPv6-capable SNAT pool. Acme's destination is resolving to an IPv6-only CDN edge so outbound chose v6.

maria: they confirmed their firewall denies non-IPv4 and then rate-limits when it sees repeated rejects, so subsequent retries were throttled = customer-facing failures. Customer is asking for immediate mitigation, not a config change on their side.

kevin: cc @sam and @eli — this is in our enterprise onboarding doc: some customers only allow IPv4. We should offer a short-term pin and a follow-up change request. :thumbsup:

sam: Agreed. Short-term we can pin Acme's VPC to an ipv4-only SNAT pool. Doing a dry-run of the reassign now. Command:```/infra reassign-snat --customer acme --pool ipv4-only --dry-run```

sam: dry-run looks clean, running real reassign in 30s. I'll post when done.

deploy-bot: scheduled job `reassign-snat-acme-1987` started by sam at 11:18:07 UTC.

eli: FYI, this happened because the balancer's upstream DNS returned AAAA for the CDN edge during the rollout. We should add a note to the runbook to check AAAA responses for sensitive customers.

sam: reassign completed @ 11:19:12. Verification: we see egress now from 203.0.113.45 (Acme allowlist block). Snippet from NAT logs:```[11:19:12] snat-map acme -> 203.0.113.45 pool=ipv4-only src=10.2.7.12 dst=198.51.100.22 proto=TCP sport=52344 dport=443```

maria: forwarded update to Acme. They report successful deliveries, and webhook error rate dropped to zero in ~3m. They asked what caused it and if we can prevent recurrence.

sam: root cause: automated dual-stack rebalancer chose IPv6-capable pool because destination AAAA existed for some edges. Mitigation: pin customer to ipv4-only pool until they confirm allowlist updates. Longer-term: add customer metadata flag `egress_preference: ipv4-only` and check DNS AAAA fallback policy before rebalancer picks a pool.

kevin: I'll open a CS ticket with the ask to update onboarding checklist and ask Acme whether they'll accept adding our IPv6 ranges.

eli: also adding a one-off alert: `snat-rebalance:used-ipv6-for-ipv4-only-customer` so support can catch this earlier.

maria: thanks all. Acme accepted the temporary fix, wants a follow-up doc for their security team. I'll schedule a handoff. :white_check_mark: 

sam: leaving note in infra-ops: `If customer has firewall allowlist, set egress_preference before rebalancer runs; avoid rebalancer during customer office hours`.

deploy-bot: ticket INFRA-4521 created by sam: "pin Acme to ipv4-only snat pool + runbook update".

maria: case closed on the immediate outage. I'll keep the follow-up open until onboarding doc and alert are in place.
